question.text: What is the minimum subscription threshold for a public issue under SEBI ICDR Regulations, excluding an offer for sale (OFS)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, minimum subscription for a public issue is at least 90% of the offer through the offer document, except in the case of an offer for sale (OFS). The Trap: 75% reflects an older minimum subscription norm under the erstwhile SEBI DIP Guidelines, not the current ICDR requirement. Note: If the minimum subscription is not received, the issuer must refund the application money forthwith and not later than four days from the closure of the issue.
